title: “Voting and not walking to protest will get us to power.”

ai.summary: Nagaland protests over highway construction in Chümoukedima area continue amid concerns about displacement and safety.

facts.claim: The four-laning of the Dimapur–Kohima National Highway was meant to improve connectivity, stimulate economic activity and make travel safer.
